description: Weather forecast API, current weather by city name or coordinates, worldwide. Current weather and forecast for any city (e.g. city=London or city=Portland, OR) or any latitude and longitude: temperature, feels, wind, humidity, precipitation and conditions now, the next 12 hours, and daily highs, lows and rain for up to 9 days. Worldwide from MET Norway (CC BY 4.0); source=nws uses the US National Weather Service for US locations. Metric with US units added. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: weather
